members.name: all
members.description: The most common way to fetch a list of results is with the `all()` method, which executes the query and returns an array of populated element models. The resulting elements will _always_ be of the type that the query started with—assets come back from asset queries, categories from category queries, and so on.

members.name: collect
members.description: Calling `.collect()` to execute a query will perform the same database call as `.all()`, but the results are wrapped in a Collection.

members.name: column
members.description: Combined with a single-column selection, the `column()` execution method will return a scalar value for each row instead of an object:

members.name: count
members.description: If you want to know how many elements match an element query, call `count()`.

members.name: exists
members.description: If you just need to check if any elements exist that match the element query, you can call `exists()`, which will return either `true` or `false`.

members.name: ids
members.description: If you just want a list of matching element IDs, you can call `ids()`. This returns an array of integers.

members.name: one
members.description: If you only need a single element, call `one()` instead of `all()`. It will return either a populated element model or `null` if no matching element exists.

members.description: Narrows the query results to users who are the author of the given entry.

members.name: authors
members.description: Narrows the query results to only users that are authors of an entry.

members.name: cache
members.description: Enables query cache for this Query.

members.name: can
members.description: Narrows the query results to only users that have a certain user permission, either directly on the user account or through one of their user groups.

members.name: canonicalsOnly
members.description: Narrows the query results to only canonical elements, including elements that reference another canonical element via `canonicalId` so long as they aren’t a draft.

members.name: clearCachedResult
members.description: Clears the cached result.

members.name: collectIds
members.description: Executes the query and returns the IDs of the resulting elements as a collection.

members.name: dateCreated
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the users’ creation dates.

members.name: dateUpdated
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the users’ last-updated dates.

members.name: eagerly
members.description: Causes the query to be used to eager-load results for the query’s source element and any other elements in its collection.

members.name: email
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the users’ email addresses.

members.name: firstName
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the users’ first names.

members.name: fixedOrder
members.description: Causes the query results to be returned in the order specified by id.

members.name: fullName
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the users’ full names.

members.name: getFieldLayouts
members.description: Returns the field layouts that could be associated with the resulting elements.

members.name: group
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the user group the users belong to.

members.name: groupId
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the user group the users belong to, per the groups’ IDs.

members.name: hasPhoto
members.description: Narrows the query results to only users that have (or don’t have) a user photo.

members.name: id
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the users’ IDs.

members.name: ignorePlaceholders
members.description: Causes the query to return matching users as they are stored in the database, ignoring matching placeholder elements that were set by craft\services\Elements::setPlaceholderElement().

members.name: inBulkOp
members.description: Narrows the query results to only users that were involved in a bulk element operation.

members.name: inReverse
members.description: Causes the query results to be returned in reverse order.

members.name: language
members.description: Determines which site(s) the users should be queried in, based on their language.

members.name: lastLoginDate
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the users’ last login dates.

members.name: lastName
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the users’ last names.

members.name: limit
members.description: Determines the number of users that should be returned.

members.name: notRelatedTo
members.description: Narrows the query results to only users that are not related to certain other elements.

members.name: offset
members.description: Determines how many users should be skipped in the results.

members.name: orderBy
members.description: Determines the order that the users should be returned in. (If empty, defaults to ` `.)

members.name: preferSites
members.description: If unique() is set, this determines which site should be selected when querying multi-site elements.

members.name: prepareSubquery
members.description: Prepares the element query and returns its subquery (which determines what elements will be returned).

members.name: prepForEagerLoading
members.description: Prepares the query for lazy eager loading.

members.name: relatedTo
members.description: Narrows the query results to only users that are related to certain other elements.

members.name: render
members.description: Executes the query and renders the resulting elements using their partial templates.

members.name: search
members.description: Narrows the query results to only users that match a search query.

members.name: siteSettingsId
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the users’ IDs in the `elements_sites` table.

members.name: status
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the users’ statuses.

members.name: trashed
members.description: Narrows the query results to only users that have been soft-deleted.

members.name: uid
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the users’ UIDs.

members.name: username
members.description: Narrows the query results based on the users’ usernames.

members.name: wasCountEagerLoaded
members.description: Returns whether the query result count was already eager loaded by the query's source element.

members.name: wasEagerLoaded
members.description: Returns whether the query results were already eager loaded by the query's source element.

members.name: with
members.description: Causes the query to return matching users eager-loaded with related elements.

members.name: withCustomFields
members.description: Sets whether custom fields should be factored into the query.

members.name: withGroups
members.description: Causes the query to return matching users eager-loaded with their user groups.

members.name: withProvisionalDrafts
members.description: Causes the query to return provisional drafts for the matching elements, when they exist for the current user.
